message.content: {"thought": "The operator group analysis confirms that FFN layers dominate total latency (91.4s out of ~91.5s total across groups, though this is sum across all layers, not wall-clock). The FFN group has 64 layers (128 occurrences) and is compute-dominated with calc_time = 91.4s. Attention is second at 61.9s. The 'other' group (norm/residual) is memory-dominated with high noc_time and dram_time relative to calc_time. I should now look at the execution timeline to understand the critical path, idle gaps, and core utilization to identify where the real wall-clock bottlenecks are.", "action": "tool", "tool": {"name": "build_execution_timeline", "arguments": {"include_sample_rows": true, "sample_limit": 12}}}
